Overview

Track any web page for changes. Checks run on our servers every 30 minutes, so monitoring continues when your browser is closed.

Stop reopening the same pages to check whether anything changed. ChangeRadar monitors website updates and shows new changes on your Chrome toolbar.

USE IT FOR
• Competitor pricing and supplier stock pages.
• Job boards, grant listings and tender announcements.
• Policy pages and terms that change without an announcement.

GET STARTED
1. Open a page you want to watch.
2. Click ChangeRadar and save the page.
3. Return to Chrome and check the toolbar badge for updates.

Checks run on our servers, including while Chrome is closed. Pages are checked on a 30-minute schedule; this is periodic monitoring, not an instant alert service.

DATA & PRIVACY
The service receives the address and title of each page you choose to monitor, plus a random device-generated ID that identifies your watch list. No account is required.

Origin, destination, pickup window, weight, commodity, equipment type and reference number.

Overview

Bold, italic, script and monospace text for X, LinkedIn and Instagram posts, using unicode that survives plain-text boxes.

Bold, italic, script and monospace text for posts on X, LinkedIn and Instagram.

Those platforms do not give you formatting. TextGlow works around it by converting your text into the equivalent Unicode characters, which survive plain-text boxes and paste anywhere.

Type your text, pick a style, copy the result.

A caveat worth knowing: because these are substituted Unicode characters rather than real formatting, screen readers may not read them the way you intend. Use them for emphasis on a word or a line, not for a whole post.
